name: What Nurses Really Want to Say But Can't Coloring Book
seoTitle: Swear Word Coloring Book for Nurses
metaDescription: An adult coloring book full of nursing themed cussing, made for nurses who need to vent after a rough shift. A funny gag gift for coworkers or friends.
summary: An adult coloring book that puts the things nurses mutter under their breath onto the page. A funny, low key way to unwind after a hard shift.
bestFor: Nurses with a salty sense of humor
whyItWorks: Nurses keep a calm face through a lot: call lights that never stop, family members with opinions, the third admission before lunch. They cannot say what they are thinking at work, which is exactly the joke here. A coloring book built around nursing related swearing gives that frustration somewhere harmless to go, and the act of coloring is a slow, screen free way to unwind after a 12 hour shift.

It works best for someone who already laughs at dark break room humor. Paired with a pack of fine tip markers or colored pencils, it becomes a complete little gift for a birthday, a white elephant swap, or a friend finishing a brutal stretch of nights. Keep the audience in mind, though. The language is the whole point, so this is a gift for a close friend or a coworker you know well, not something to hand over at a formal pinning ceremony or leave out where kids will find it.
goodToKnow: Contains strong language by design, so give it to someone who will find that funny.
Markers and pencils are not mentioned in the title, so plan to add your own set.
Check the listing for the page count and whether pages are printed on one side if markers might bleed.

faq.q: Is this appropriate as an office or unit gift?
faq.a: Only if you know the group's humor well. It is better suited to a close friend or a casual gift exchange than a formal workplace event.

faq.q: Would a nursing student enjoy it?
faq.a: Many students will, especially during clinical rotations and exam stress. The jokes land best with anyone who has spent time on a hospital floor.
